entity: Share of argued Supreme Court cases coming from state courts since 2020
what_we_add: 19 of 295 argued cases since 2020 (6.4%) and the lowest-since-1946 comparison
why: Chemerinsky, Vladeck and Bannon all report the same decline in state-court cases on the merits docket, same direction. None has the full since-2020 count or the 1946 baseline.
